text:
Source: https://github.com/thunderbird/thunderbird-desktop/commit/f293bf201b32dc744821b65992d3ec86b503ea82

Coverage: Actual diff inspected; related inverse/reland duplicate hunks checked as a chain.
Full YAML diff adds ESR release notes URL. Initial update-channel condition failed beta tasks; followup14a7230d uses release-types instead (D213242). Endpoint uses release-types for product-details and both channel/type where show-url requires them.

commit f293bf201b32dc744821b65992d3ec86b503ea82
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Jun 4 22:00:00 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Jun 4 22:00:00 2024 +0000

    Bug 1899495 - Set correct release notes URL for esr channel via AUS. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D212116

diff --git a/mail/config/whats_new_page.yml b/mail/config/whats_new_page.yml
index 0bea15e390e..dab3038e4e4 100644
--- a/mail/config/whats_new_page.yml
+++ b/mail/config/whats_new_page.yml
@@ -5,6 +5,13 @@
 - type: product-details
   # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
   url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/releasenotes?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel={release-type}
+  conditions:
+      release-types: [release, beta]
+- type: product-details
+  # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
+  url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/releasenotes?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel=esr
+  conditions:
+      update-channel: esr
 - type: show-url
   # yamllint disable-line rule:line-length
   url: https://live.thunderbird.net/thunderbird/whatsnew?locale=%LOCALE%&version={version}&channel={release-type}&oldversion=%OLD_VERSION%
